briefing: Markets were flat today (NASDAQ +0.0%, S&P 500 +0.1%) with no clear directional signal. Cash reserve of $389.29 sits below our $500 minimum buy threshold, so per past lessons we're holding rather than forcing a new position on a neutral day. All 7 existing positions remain untouched, letting the automatic stop-loss and profit-target rules handle any needed exits.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Risk-off doesn't always mean a market crash — it can simply mean staying disciplined and not deploying capital when signals are weak or cash reserves are too thin to build a meaningful position. Holding cash on a neutral day, rather than forcing a trade, protects the portfolio from chasing low-conviction setups.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「避險」（Risk-Off）不一定代表市場暴跌，也可以是指在訊號不明朗、或現金儲備不足以建立有意義倉位時，保持紀律、不勉強進場。在方向不明的交易日選擇持有現金而非硬性交易，能避免追逐低把握度的機會，保護整體投資組合。

market_education.summary_en: Major U.S. indices traded essentially flat today, with the S&P 500 up just 0.1% and the Nasdaq unchanged on the day. Without strong economic data or earnings catalysts to push sentiment in either direction, trading volume and conviction stayed muted across most sectors. This kind of low-volatility, directionless session often reflects investors waiting for the next major data point before committing new capital.
market_education.summary_zh: 美股主要指數今日走勢平淡，標普500指數僅微升0.1%，納斯達克指數則持平收市。市場缺乏重大經濟數據或業績消息刺激，投資人普遍觀望，成交量與方向性均偏弱。這種低波動、方向不明的交易日，往往反映市場正等待下一個關鍵訊號才會有較大動作。
